cards.text: In those days, war breaks out, friend, and there are a WHOLE lot of crowns in this fight. On one side are Amraphel king of Shinar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam and their allies. On the other side are Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah and theirs.

cards.question: Sodom's side comes together as allies. Where do they gather?

cards.text: Here's the backstory: for twelve years, Sodom's side had been subject to Chedorlaomer king of Elam. Twelve years of saying "Yes sir" to the same guy.

cards.question: After twelve years under Chedorlaomer, what does Sodom's side do in the thirteenth year?

cards.text: In the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him go out and defeat one people after another, from the Rephaites in Ashteroth-karnaim to the Amalekites and the Amorites in Hazazon-tamar. Friend, that's not a march, that's a HIGHLIGHT REEL.
Then Sodom's side marches out and lines up for battle in the Valley of Siddim. Time to count heads.

cards.question: Kings lined up in the Valley of Siddim: Chedorlaomer's side has ___ and Sodom's side has ___
Sodom's side wins the battle in the Valley of Siddim.

cards.text: Sodom's side breaks and runs. Five kings showed up for a battle, and it turned into a FOOTRACE.

cards.question: As the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah flee, some of their men fall into something the Valley of Siddim is full of. What is it?

cards.text: The survivors flee to the hill country, and the four kings take all the goods and all the food of Sodom and Gomorrah. That's not a win, friend, that's a MOVING TRUCK.

cards.question: Along with the goods, the four kings carry off a man who's living in Sodom, plus his possessions. Who is he?

cards.text: Then someone who escaped comes and brings the news to Abram the Hebrew. No phones back then, friend, so breaking news had to show up in person.

cards.question: Abram lives near the Oaks of Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner are all bound to Abram by ___

cards.text: Abram hears that his relative has been captured. No sleeping on this one, friend.

cards.question: Abram mobilizes trained men who were born in his own household. How many?

cards.text: Abram and his men set out after the four kings and chase them as far as Dan. Those kings just beat FIVE kings, friend, and I need a pep talk to answer a call from an unknown number.

cards.question: During the ___, Abram ___ his forces and routs Chedorlaomer's army

cards.text: Abram chases them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus, and the army that cleaned out Sodom is now the one RUNNING. He also brings back the women and the rest of the people.

cards.question: Abram brings back Lot and his possessions, but he has to leave the goods behind.

cards.text: Abram returns from defeating Chedorlaomer, and the king of Sodom goes out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh, the King's Valley. The last time this king was in a valley, friend, he was running OUT of it.
Then someone new comes out to Abram: Melchizedek, king of Salem.

cards.question: Melchizedek, king of Salem, brings something out for Abram. What is it?
Melchizedek is king of Salem, and he's also a priest of God Most High.

cards.text: Melchizedek blesses Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth. A king AND a priest, friend, and here I am proud when my apron makes it to lunch without a smudge.

cards.question: Next, Melchizedek blesses God Most High. What does he bless Him for?

answers.text: Delivering Abram's enemies into his hand
Giving Abram a son in his old age
Giving Abram the whole land of Canaan

cards.question: After the blessing, Abram gives Melchizedek a ___ of everything

cards.text: Now the king of Sodom speaks up, and he's got an offer for Abram.

cards.question: The king of Sodom's offer to Abram: give me the ___, and take the ___ for yourself
Abram takes the king of Sodom's deal and keeps the goods.

cards.text: Abram says he has raised his hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth. He won't take even a thread or a sandal strap from the king of Sodom.

cards.question: Abram won't take even a thread or a sandal strap from the king of Sodom. Why?

answers.text: So the king can't say he made Abram rich
So the people of Sodom will trust him
So the four kings won't come back for it

cards.text: Abram will accept nothing but what his men have eaten, and then he brings up the men who went with him. Friend, I shared a drawer with an expired coupon that still believed in itself, and even IT would've grabbed this deal.

cards.question: Abram takes nothing for himself, but he says Aner, Eshcol and Mamre, the men who went with him, may take their portion.

cards.text: Hold that thought, friend, because Abram's story is just warming up, like the oven before the very first batch.

findings.problem: Half of stop 1's 10 choice cards can't be reasoned out from earlier cards. Card 2 (Valley of Siddim vs Elah or Jezreel), card 7 (four and five, when card 1 names only two kings per side plus 'allies'), card 10 (tar pits vs wells or streams), card 14 (treaty vs marriage or debt) and card 16 (318 vs 600 or 3000) are all pure recall of details the baker hasn't seen. Card 18 (night vs noon) is close to that too. Most of the stop's choice cards are discovery questions, not informed guesses.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.
